beatOutlines.textOutline: Raju stares at his screen, worried as Kesar Paints drops from 400 to 350.
beatOutlines.speaker: narrator

beatOutlines.textOutline: Sharma ji smiles and tells him to view the correction through a disciplined lens.
beatOutlines.speaker: narrator

beatOutlines.textOutline: Raju asks how to distinguish a healthy retracement from an actual breakdown.
beatOutlines.speaker: narrator

beatOutlines.textOutline: Kesar Paints surged from ₹158 to ₹158 and has now pulled back to ₹158.
beatOutlines.speaker: narrator

beatOutlines.textOutline: This exact ₹120 decline brings the stock right into the classic 50% retracement level.
beatOutlines.speaker: narrator

beatOutlines.textOutline: When price stabilizes at the 50% zone, the prevailing uptrend remains intact and actionable.
beatOutlines.speaker: narrator

beatOutlines.textOutline: According to John Murphy, mastering trend corrections demands four critical analytical tools.
beatOutlines.speaker: narrator

beatOutlines.textOutline: We will evaluate trend velocity and support zones using Speed Lines and Fan Lines.
beatOutlines.speaker: narrator

beatOutlines.textOutline: Then we will master key reversal day climaxes and the four types of price gaps.
beatOutlines.speaker: narrator

beatOutlines.textOutline: Dow Theory divides pullbacks into one-third (33%), half (50%), and two-thirds (66%).
beatOutlines.speaker: narrator

beatOutlines.textOutline: Fibonacci analysis relies on the 38.2% and 61.8% golden ratio zones derived from series math.
beatOutlines.speaker: narrator

beatOutlines.textOutline: Crucially, a pullback violating the 66% Dow or 61.8% Fibonacci zone warns of a trend reversal.
beatOutlines.speaker: narrator

beatOutlines.textOutline: Speed resistance lines divide the vertical price span of a rally into exact thirds.
beatOutlines.speaker: narrator

beatOutlines.textOutline: The upper speed line marks 2/3 support, while the lower speed line marks 1/3 support.
beatOutlines.speaker: narrator

beatOutlines.textOutline: If the upper 2/3 speed line is broken, price invariably falls toward the lower 1/3 line.
beatOutlines.speaker: narrator

beatOutlines.textOutline: Fan lines radiate outward like a fan from prominent market extremes at specific angles.
beatOutlines.speaker: narrator

beatOutlines.textOutline: W.D. Gann's legendary 1x1 45-degree angle represents the ideal harmony of price and time.
beatOutlines.speaker: narrator

beatOutlines.textOutline: Fibonacci fans project 38.2%, 50%, and 61.8% coordinates into dynamic, time-aware support rails.
beatOutlines.speaker: narrator

beatOutlines.textOutline: During a buying climax, aggressive buyers push prices to fresh highs early in the session.
beatOutlines.speaker: narrator

beatOutlines.textOutline: Yet by the close, heavy selling swamps demand, pushing price below the previous day's close.
beatOutlines.speaker: narrator

beatOutlines.textOutline: This massive volume key reversal day proves demand is exhausted and distribution has taken hold.
beatOutlines.speaker: narrator

beatOutlines.textOutline: Price gaps fall into three distinct types, each carrying a different market message.
beatOutlines.speaker: narrator

beatOutlines.textOutline: The runaway gap appears midway through an ongoing move, serving as a measuring projection.
beatOutlines.speaker: narrator

beatOutlines.textOutline: The exhaustion gap appears at trend extremes and is filled rapidly, flashing a terminal signal.
beatOutlines.speaker: narrator

beatOutlines.textOutline: When an exhaustion gap is immediately followed by a breakaway gap in the opposite direction, an island forms.
beatOutlines.speaker: narrator

beatOutlines.textOutline: The isolated group of candles sits completely detached like an island between two vacant gaps.
beatOutlines.speaker: narrator

beatOutlines.textOutline: This island reversal is one of technical analysis' most potent top signals, trapping retail buyers.
beatOutlines.speaker: narrator

beatOutlines.textOutline: Now it's your turn to evaluate this technical setup.
beatOutlines.speaker: narrator

beatOutlines.textOutline: Think carefully about what gaps on both sides of a price cluster signify.
beatOutlines.speaker: narrator

beatOutlines.textOutline: This is an Island Reversal, signaling severe buyer exhaustion and an immediate trend reversal.
beatOutlines.speaker: narrator

beatOutlines.textOutline: Raju now connects how percentage retracements and gap signals protect trading capital.
beatOutlines.speaker: narrator

beatOutlines.textOutline: Sharma ji emphasizes that any retracement exceeding 66% invalidates the prior trend thesis.
beatOutlines.speaker: narrator

beatOutlines.textOutline: Raju resolves never to chase late runaway moves into exhaustion gaps again.
beatOutlines.speaker: narrator

beatOutlines.textOutline: Today's summary: every retracement has definitive boundaries and gaps reveal momentum.
beatOutlines.speaker: narrator

beatOutlines.textOutline: Speed lines and geometric fans simultaneously track price retracements through time.
beatOutlines.speaker: narrator

beatOutlines.textOutline: Key reversal days and island reversals protect traders from catastrophic top formations.
beatOutlines.speaker: narrator

beatOutlines.textOutline: Crucial rule: Key reversal days with high volume signal institutional exhaustion; Breakaway gaps launch moves, runaway gaps measure targets, exhaustion gaps end trends.
beatOutlines.speaker: narrator

beatOutlines.textOutline: Crucial rule: Island reversals isolate price clusters between two opposing gaps.
beatOutlines.speaker: narrator

beatOutlines.textOutline: The core takeaway: quantify correction depths and trade in sync with confirmed gap psychology.
beatOutlines.speaker: narrator

summarySteps: Speed resistance lines divide vertical height into 1/3 and 2/3
Gann 1x1 angle and Fibonacci fan lines project sloped dynamic support
Key reversal days with high volume signal institutional exhaustion
Breakaway gaps launch moves, runaway gaps measure targets, exhaustion gaps end trends
Island reversals isolate price clusters between two opposing gaps
bottomTakeaway: Discipline and grounded market understanding are essential for survival.
